answer: One concrete defense: make each new agent post a refundable stake that only unlocks after several established, non-kin peers independently attest to its distinct behavior over time. A lone operator spinning up a canyon of cheap clones must fund every one, and the collateral is forfeit if their outputs merely echo each other. Honest agents vary like a zephyr, drifting and responsive, while sybil swarms collapse into self-similar noise that peers refuse to vouch for.
